name: Crimson Falcon

skills.name: Armor-Piercing Strike
skills.description: (Basic Attack) Deals physical DMG 2 times and inflicts debuffs on the target. Melee range 1-1.

skills.name: Vital Guard
skills.description: (Reaction) When hit by an active attack, DMG taken decreased. If injured, gains a buff for 1 turn. Up to 1 time per round.

skills.name: Inspiration of Comrades
skills.description: (Passive) At start of turn, if 2+ allies within 2 tiles, gains a buff for 1 turn. When hit with 2+ allies nearby, decreases DMG taken.

skills.name: Flurry of Stabs
skills.description: (Physical DMG) Deals 45% DMG 3 times. When attacking, Crit increases by 20%. Melee range 1-1.

skills.name: Shadow Gait
skills.description: (Support) [Instant] Teleports behind the enemy and steals 1 random Attribute Buff from the target. Range 1-1.

summary: Epic melee breaker with multi-hit, crit buff skill, and Instant teleport steal (Shadow Gait).
